trial_title: To Study the Impact of Radiation Treatment After Surgery in Patient With Locally Advanced Thyroid Cancer.
brief_summary: This trial deals with cancers of the thyroid gland which are advanced at the local site of thyroid. These cancers are treated with surgery and complete removal of the thyroid gland. But due to advanced nature, there is risk of re-occurrence. Radiotherapy can be used to prevent this re-occurrence. This study attempt to see the effect of radiotherapy in preventing re-occurrence and its side effects in advanced thyroid cancer.

eligibility_table.criterion: All patients of differentiated thyroid cancer (papillary/follicular/poorly differentiated/) who have undergone total/completion thyroidectomy at our institute and having at least two of the following features (listed below) intra-operatively and/or on histopathology
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has metastatic papillary thyroid cancer but has not undergone total/completion thyroidectomy at the institute.

eligibility_table.criterion: Gross extrathyroidal spread into soft tissues of the neck, trachea, esophagus, recurrent laryngeal nerve (constituting stage T4a)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has gross extrathyroidal spread into soft tissues, as indicated by the large tumor size and proximity to critical structures.
There is no specific information provided about R1/shave resections; further details on surgical outcomes are needed.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the surgical resection of the patient's thyroid cancer show any evidence of R1 margins, defined as the presence of microscopic residual disease at the resection margin?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no specific information provided about R2 resections; further details on surgical outcomes are needed.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any gross residual disease remaining after the neck mass resection?

eligibility_table.criterion: Multiple lymph nodes positive(>2) with perinodal extension at level VI
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has multiple lymph nodes positive for metastasis, as indicated by the history of metastatic spread.

eligibility_table.criterion: Normal baseline haematological and biochemical parameters.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's history of weight loss and lethargy suggests abnormal baseline hematological and biochemical parameters.
The patient has papillary thyroid cancer, which is not anaplastic or medullary.
The patient has a history of radiation therapy (XRT), which is relevant to the exclusion criteria.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently pregnant or has the patient been pregnant within the last 12 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient unwilling to participate in the study.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the patient's willingness to participate in the study.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient willing to participate in the study after being informed of the potential risks and benefits of radiation treatment?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Patient unwilling to participate in the study.
